verdict.rationale: The Transaction Data docs say aggregation data refreshes daily and can be refreshed on demand through dedicated Data Refresh endpoints when fresher data is needed. The Account Balance service also documents real-time versus cached balance retrieval, so first-party API-triggered refresh is clearly documented. missing for 10: detailed refresh semantics in the evidence (async completion behavior, rate limits or refresh frequency caps, how to detect when a refresh is done), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
